title: Understanding Bias and Variance
text: Adding a feature of random numbers between $$0$$ and $$1$$ to a model can affect its bias and variance. Consider how this might impact the model's ability to generalize to new data.

title: Effect on Bias
text: Bias refers to the error introduced by approximating a real-world problem, which may be complex, by a simplified model. Adding random noise as a feature does not help the model capture the true underlying pattern.

title: Effect on Variance
text: Variance refers to how much the model's predictions would change if we used a different training dataset. Adding random noise can increase variance because the model might try to fit this noise.

title: Evaluating the Statement
text: Does adding a feature of random numbers between $$0$$ and $$1$$ increase the model's bias?

title: Final Conclusion
text: Based on your understanding of bias and variance, evaluate the statement: Adding a feature of random numbers between $$0$$ and $$1$$ increases bias.
